text:
evan-partnerships: Quick thread for NebulaEdge partner summit booth + joint talk next Wed. Need final speaker list, demo fallback, and swag drop-off plan.
sara-marketing: I can own swag. Budget $50 per external speaker. Thinking co-branded insulated bottle + pocket notebook.
mike-events: AV/accessibility: I'll book captions and ASL. Also set a speaker green room 30m before. Any dietary notes for on-site hospitality?
anya-ops: Demo fallback: we'll run a local container snapshot on booth laptop that can serve pre-recorded responses if the cloud endpoint flaps. I'll add health-check script and a big red slide saying "Using offline demo" if fallback in use.
rachel-ux: I'll design a small double-sided card: front = thank you + QR to recording, back = accessibility + contact. Will keep it lightweight for international shipping.
ship-bot: Logistics manifest created: MAN-4432. Drop-off window Fri 9am-12pm at venue warehouse. Intl shipments must be in by Thu to clear customs.
sara-marketing: OK I’ll source the bottles and notebooks. Can we personalize notes? small handwritten line?
ev an-partnerships: yes, personalize. Evan will collect names + roles by Tue noon.
mike-events: Rehearsal schedule: vendor tech check T-60m, speaker mic check T-30m, run captions test. I'll post calendar invites.
anya-ops: Ops checklist snippet: ```
- T-90m: power on demo laptop
- T-45m: pull local snapshot, run health-check
- T-15m: final latency check vs cloud endpoint
- Live: monitor p50, if >500ms for 90s flip to offline
```
rachel-ux: Note copy for insert: "Thanks for joining our NebulaEdge session. Recording + assets: https://redwood.example/nebula. Need access? access@redwood.com" ok?
sara-marketing: Perfect. Ship-bot: confirm manifest and pickup?
ship-bot: Pickup confirmed for MAN-4432. Tracking: https://ship.example/MAN-4432
ev an-partnerships: Actions: Evan - collect speaker addresses; Sara - finalize swag + note copy; Mike - captions + green room; Anya - demo snapshot + runbook; Rachel - insert design. Follow-up Wed morning. Thanks! :rocket:
